jobs.title: Lighting Programmer FTC
jobs.description:
**Salary:** £882.79 per week

**Location:** London Coliseum & other locations as required

We're looking for a skilled and collaborative Lighting Programmer to help bring ambitious productions to life. Working closely with visiting Lighting Designers, you'll programme and realise creative lighting designs for productions at the London Coliseum and other venues, ensuring artistic vision is delivered with technical excellence.

This pivotal role involves programming lighting systems, supporting rehearsals and performances, integrating visiting companies' lighting control systems with ENO's infrastructure, and ensuring smooth operation throughout productions. You'll combine technical expertise with creative insight, helping to deliver exceptional experiences for audiences and performers alike.

If you're passionate about live performance and collaborating with world-class creative teams, we'd love to hear from you.

**Requirements:**

* An established background in the core skills relevant to this position including extensive experience of high level programming of shows on an ETC Apex, quickly and accurately, in a repertory environment.
* Understanding of the particular needs of the Repertory environment and programme accordingly
* Knowledge of operating and programming other common lighting control systems– MA, Hog etc.
* Thorough understanding of Lighting System protocols– DMX512-A, sACN, Art-Net, RDM MIDI Timecode etc.
* Excellent knowledge of data networks and dimmer management systems.
* Ability to carry out fault-finding assessments of the control and dimming systems and advising on plan of action following diagnosis.
* Ability to complete tasks to deadline with minimal supervision
* Ability to rig lighting elements appropriately
* Familiarity with both current and legacy lighting accessories, including scrollers, low voltage equipment, shutter units, LED drivers.
* Confidence in working safely at height
* Technical proficiency, a positive and professional attitude, and a ‘hands on’ approach to the job

Please see our recruitment pack for full details of the role.

**Application deadline:** 5pm, Sunday 11 October

**Interviews:** 15 & 16 October 2026

**Reasonable adjustments:** If you require any reasonable adjustments for the application or interview process, please contact workwithus@eno.org

**Feedback:** Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are only able to provide individual feedback to those candidates who reach the interview stage

*English National Opera is an Equal Opportunities employer, and we strive to create an inclusive working environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve. As we work to address underrepresentation in our workforce, we particularly encourage potential candidates from underrepresented groups and communities to apply, including those from global majority backgrounds and/or with protected characteristics, including race, disability, sexual orientation, gender reassignment and religion and belief. We will provide appropriate support for candidates with access requirements if they identify as disabled. This includes during the application process and through candidate assessment stages.*

jobs.title: Head of Engineering (Associate Director) - Kings Cross Estate, London
jobs.description:
**Purpose of the Role**

The Head of Engineering Services will provide strategic leadership and operational oversight for all engineering functions across the Kings Cross Estate, ensuring the seamless delivery of building services, infrastructure & and sustainability initiatives. This role requires a visionary and strategic thinker, capable of aligning engineering operations with long-term estate objectives, enhancing asset value, and supporting a first-class experience for occupiers, residents, visitors, and stakeholders.

The HES will work hand in glove with the Operations Director, to whom they report on a day to day basis. There will be a dotted line to Director of Engineering Services within SMR with a view to ensuring the HES has access to a wider group of specialists and expertise within the wider Savills business to call upon as necessary to perform their role effectively.

The HES will provide clear strategic technical direction, strong, practical leadership, as well as operational planning. This is very much a solutions focussed role, underpinned by sound commercial acumen.

The HES will be directly responsible for managing the senior engineering manager, energy manager, and IT Digital, Innovation and Project Lead.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Develop and deliver a long-term engineering services strategy that supports the estate’s commercial, residential, retail, leisure, and public realm objectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the executive team on engineering, technical risks, energy management, and sustainability.
* Drive innovation in engineering solutions, integrating emerging technologies, smart building systems, and sustainable practices.
* Plan, forecast, and manage capital investment programmes and budgets to ensure the estate’s infrastructure is future-proof, resilient, and compliant.
* Lead the commercial management of key hard service contracts, have financial oversight (comprehensive agreements), and lead procurement and compliance at site level.

**Operational Management**

* Lead and oversee all building engineering services, including mechanical, electrical, public health, energy, and critical systems.
* Ensure engineering operations comply with statutory regulations, health & safety requirements, and industry best practice.
* Develop and manage performance standards, KPIs, and service-level agreements for in-house teams and third-party contractors.
* Oversee the maintenance strategy, ensuring a balance between reliability, cost efficiency, and sustainability.

**Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Lead a multi-disciplinary engineering team, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Build strong working relationships with occupiers, residents, retailers, local authorities, and service providers.
* Communicate complex engineering concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, ensuring transparency and collaboration.

**Sustainability & Innovation**

* Champion the estate’s sustainability and net-zero ambitions, embedding energy efficiency and low-carbon technologies into operations.
* Identify opportunities for renewable energy, circular economy solutions, and intelligent building systems.
* Support the estate’s ESG commitments by integrating sustainable engineering into asset management and development plans.

**Health & Safety**

* Take and maintain responsibility for Health & Safety compliance for all technical systems and equipment.
* Ensure that every incident and accident is fully recorded, reported (including to insurers) and investigated and any remedial measures diligently attended to.
* Ensure the technical team achieve full compliance with statutory legislation (LOLER) and ensure that all records are fully maintained and available for inspection through DataStation
* Advise the Estate Director, Operations Director and Savills Technical Director immediately of any potential threats or reputational damage, major incidents or accidents resulting from an issue with the technical aspects of the estate. Report on any tenant related issue or any issue that could or will involve the HSE or EHO.

**Skills, Knowledge and Experience**

Key attributes:

* Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long-term vision with operational realities.
* Commercially astute, with strong financial and budget management skills.
* Collaborative leader who inspires trust, credibility, and engagement.
* Resilient, adaptable, and able to operate effectively in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

Essential:

* Proven senior leadership experience in engineering or building services within a large, complex estate or portfolio (e.g., mixed-use, commercial, or critical infrastructure).
* Strong strategic and commercial mindset with the ability to align engineering services with estate-wide business goals.
* Ideally holds H&S qualification ISOH/NEBOSH.
* Fully conversant with Electrical installation and current IEE regulations/ British Standard BS 7671
* Operational knowledge of critical works and change management systems.
* Operational knowledge of HV/LV Networks and shutdown management
* Exceptional leadership, influencing, and communication skills, with experience managing large teams and external partners.
* Track record of delivering innovation, sustainability, and value creation through engineering services.

Desirable:

* Chartered Engineer status or equivalent professional qualification.
* Experience in smart building technologies and digital transformation in engineering services.
* Exposure to estates with high public footfall and complex stakeholder environments.

This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of duties, and you will be expected to perform different tasks as necessitated by your role within the organisation and the changes in the wider King’s Cross Estate development

Working Hours - 09:00 – 17:30 – Core Hours

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Underwriting & Pricing
jobs.description:
**ABOUT HOMEPROTECT**

**Cover for Almost every Home**

We founded Homeprotect on a simple principle - to provide protection to people underserved by the home insurance industry. Since 2002, we've been combining smart technology with real human expertise to protect hundreds of thousands of unique homes across the UK, and we're just getting started.

If you're someone who loves solving interesting problems, taking ownership and working with a team that aims high, speaks up and lifts each other, Homeprotect is a place where you can do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real difference for our customers.

**What It's Like to Work Here**

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do our people. We're a small but perfectly formed team of insurance specialists, technologists, data scientists and customer champions - all bringing individual expertise, an appetite for innovation and a shared ambition to protect the homes and things people love.

We work at pace, but we trust our people to work in a way that brings out their best. You'll collaborate closely across teams, have real ownership from day one and see the impact you have first-hand with flexible working to help you balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life.

We've been recognised as a Great Place to Work UK for seven consecutive years - most recently ranked 29th nationally, jumping 71 places in a single year.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

Underwriting & Pricing decides which risks Homeprotect takes on and what we charge for them, one of the company's most strategically important and technically demanding domains, and one whose output, the price and terms of a quote, ripples through nearly every other part of the business: the journey that presents it to a customer, the policy created from it, and the numbers reported on afterwards.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to shape the technical direction of this domain as its platform modernises, and to work across the boundary with the teams that depend on it, so pricing and underwriting changes can be made quickly, safely and with confidence across the business, not just within one team's codebase. At this level, you'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, defining technical direction rather than executing someone else's, and your influence will extend beyond a single team: you'll be the person other engineering teams turn to when a change touches pricing, quoting or underwriting logic.

Success in this role means Underwriting & Pricing's architecture and technical standards let the business change pricing and risk logic quickly and safely, and that other teams depending on the domain can build against it with confidence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Technical Direction & Architecture**

* Define and own the technical direction and architecture for the Underwriting & Pricing domain: the pricing and rating engines, underwriting rules, risk appetite logic and quote calculation services.
* Make architectural decisions that affect multiple teams or systems, and document them clearly enough that others can act on them independently.
* Identify and drive the resolution of significant technical risk or complexity before it becomes a business problem, particularly around the accuracy and auditability of pricing and underwriting decisions.
* Lead the technical design of complex, cross-team initiatives from first principles through to delivery.

**Cross-Domain Technical Leadership**

* Act as the technical point of contact for other engineering teams whose systems depend on pricing, quoting or underwriting output.
* Influence architecture and engineering standards beyond the immediate team, helping the wider engineering organisation make sound decisions wherever they touch this domain.
* Represent Underwriting & Pricing in cross-team or organisation-wide technical discussions and decisions.

**Product & Business Partnership**

* Partner with the domain's Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and Actuarial and Commercial colleagues, to translate pricing and risk strategy into a technical direction that can support it.
* Help stakeholders understand technical trade-offs and constraints, and shape pragmatic solutions that balance commercial ambition with engineering rigour.

**Mentoring & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop senior engineers and emerging technical leaders within the team.
* Drive improvements to engineering practices, testing and operational rigour appropriate to a domain where correctness has a direct commercial consequence.
* Contribute to Homeprotect's wider engineering standards and architecture as the organisation's product engineering model matures.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

**Essential**

* Proven experience as a Staff Engineer or equivalent, owning technical direction across multiple teams, platforms or a significant business capability.
* Strong track record of defining architecture and engineering standards independently, and communicating them clearly through documentation, design and discussion.
* Experience influencing engineering decisions across teams without relying on formal authority.
* Comfortable working with rules-heavy, calculation-intensive systems, where correctness, auditability and rigorous testing matter as much as delivery speed.
* Strong hands-on experience in at least one modern backend language, such as C# or Java (or a comparable object-oriented language).
* Deep, hands-on understanding of modern software engineering practices: continuous integration and deployment, automated testing, observability and cloud-native development.
* Experience operating production systems, in a public cloud environment such as Azure or GCP, that need to be reliable, secure, performant and auditable.
* Excellent communication skills, able to build trust and drive alignment with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, including senior stakeholders.

**Desirable**

* Experience in general insurance, financial services or another regulated industry.
* Understanding of pricing, underwriting, actuarial or risk modelling concepts.
* Familiarity with Python, useful for working closely with Actuarial and data science colleagues on pricing and risk models.
* Experience building or evolving a platform or set of services consumed by multiple other engineering teams.
* Exposure to event-driven or distributed systems.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve engineering productivity.

**BENEFITS**

We want you to feel rewarded, supported and set up to thrive throughout your career with us.

**Learning and Growth:** We invest in your development through structured learning, mentoring, buddying, on-the-job experience and cross-functional projects. We support role-relevant professional qualifications where they'll make the biggest difference, and our Lunch and Learn sessions to help you stay connected to what’s going on right across the business.

**Health and Wellbeing:** Your wellbeing matters here. We offer private healthcare through BUPA, an Employee Assistance Programme covering legal, financial and counselling support for you, a Wellbeing Centre with online tools and resources, regular wellbeing seminars and workshops, annual flu jabs and an annual eye care voucher.

**Financial Security and Reward:** We offer an annual discretionary bonus scheme upto 30% of your base pay, life insurance at four times your salary, and a pension with Aegon. You'll also receive a significant discount on Homeprotect home insurance - with a friends and family discount too, and a staff referral bonus when someone you recommend joins the team.

**Time Off:** 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy or sell up to five additional days each year.

**Genuine Flexible Working** We trust our people to work in a way that best suits them - with flexible working to balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life. We ask that everyone comes into the office at least once a week, as we believe in-person connection is important for collaboration, culture and building great relationships. You'll receive a homeworking starter kit from day one and can claim towards additional home office equipment within your first six months.

**Purpose and Community:** We care about more than just the work. Through our charity partnership with Refuge, the UK's largest specialist domestic abuse charity and regular social, wellbeing and charitable events throughout the year, there are plenty of ways to connect, give back and feel part of something bigger.

**UNIQUE AS STANDARD**

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively encourage applications from all backgrounds. We believe in celebrating difference - everything that makes both our customers and our people unique. We consider visa sponsorship on a case by case basis for the right candidate, so please don't let that stop you from applying.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any extra help with your application or have any requirements at any stage of the recruitment journey, we want the process to work for you.

*Your data will be maintained in line with our recruitment data privacy policy.*

***Regulatory Responsibilities***

*As an FCA regulated insurer, doing the right thing isn't a compliance requirement - it's simply how we work. All colleagues are expected to uphold the FCA Individual Conduct Rules (1–6) and act with integrity, due skill and care, openness with regulators and a genuine commitment to delivering good outcomes for our customers.*

*You'll work within approved processes and authority limits, keep accurate and auditable records, protect data under UK GDPR and our information security policies, escalate risks and exceptions promptly, report incidents, breaches and any financial crime or sanctions concerns (including via whistleblowing), support vulnerable customers with reasonable adjustments, and complete all mandatory training to maintain competence.*

*If the role falls within SM&CR, a supplementary document outlining the key regulatory responsibilities will be provided.*
